items.docs: Retrieve a vault by resource name.

params.name: orderBy
params.description:
SQL-like ordering specifications.
Supports the fields `display_name` and `create_time`.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. The service may return fewer than this value.

params.name: pageToken
params.description:
A page token, received from the previous list call as `nextPageToken`.
Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.

When paginating, all other parameters must match the call that provided
the page token.

params.name: skip
params.description:
How many results to skip.

Note: may be used alongside token-based pagination (see `pageToken`),
although this won't be needed for most use cases.

items.docs: Retrieve a list of all vaults accessible to the authenticated user.
